items.title: Wilson "Willie T" Turbinton Interview, 1990-09
items.q: I was saying one of the greatest things that I remember from communicating with Cannonball Adler, he told me, no matter how great you think you are

ctx.x: I was saying one of the greatest things that I remember from communicating with Cannonball Adler, he told me, no matter how great you think you are, there's always a performer that's playing somewhere else, that the people that's experiencing them at the time, if they enjoyed it, they consider that great. So, you know, you can only play in one place at a time, no matter how great you are. So if you let somebody else's greatness determine how you feel about yourself, it's the biggest mistake that you could ever…

It just depends on the setting. I can play everything from the Little Richards to whatever is fusion to all of that. And I think to a large degree that that has been our problem. People having record companies sometimes want you to have, to market you, they want you to record in one mode. And you know I know personally I can sing, I can sing jazz, I can sing rock and roll, or whatever. And when you're promoting yourself no one wants to hear you blow your horn. And since I've come to that realization I sometimes…
